## How it is checked

<!-- The scenario that shows the change (a bug fix needs one that failed before the fix), and the numbers or shots that show it. -->

- [ ] `./skate check` is green
- [ ] `./skate check --full` is green (physics, rendering, UI, fonts)
- [ ] `./skate monkey` passes (input, menus or the frame loop)
- [ ] Numbers are in `data/*.json`, not in code
- [ ] New dependency or architecture change: a dated entry in `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] New third-party asset: its licence in the folder's `LICENSES.md` and in `CREDITS.md`
